verdict.rationale: Luma's Modify Video V2 reshapes existing footage and can swap specific elements such as the wall or the wardrobe. Luma says the lighting and performance are preserved, which partly supports the 'rest of the frame stays intact' requirement. However, the evidence shows no element-targeting controls, such as masks or region selection, and gives no guarantee that untouched regions stay pixel-intact. The 'swap the world' wording also suggests whole-scene restyling rather than isolated element edits. Missing for 10: documented element-level targeting (mask, region or object selection), explicit preservation of untouched parts of the frame, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Modify Video results.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact

citations.quote: Modify Video V2 reshapes footage you already have. Swap the wall, the world, the wardrobe. The lighting holds. The performance survives.
Transform people into entirely new characters while preserving performance.
